# McCabe

McCabe is cited once in the AFDK 2024 report as the author of research (dated 2011) that underpins recommendations on the content of patient education for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The reference appears alongside Woo et al. (2021) in the context of AFDK's guidance on the ABC Pathway, where the report states that patient education should include information adapted to the individual patient's situation [^src1]. No further biographical, institutional, or relationship details are available in the corpus.

## Mentions

- Page 100: "I relation til The ABC Pathway anbefaler AFDK, at patientundervisningen bør indeholde informationer listet i nedenstående tabel tilpasset den enkelte patients situation (McCabe, 2011; Woo et al., 2021)" [^src1]
